classes.name: HostResolverProc
classes.description: Class managing DNS host resolution procedures with fallback and chaining capabilities.

methods.name: HostResolverProc::HostResolverProc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the host resolver procedure chain with optional fallback.

methods.description: Sets the previous resolver in the chain, ensuring no cycles.

methods.description: Retrieves the last resolver in the chain.
